definitions.explanation: The traditional Japanese writing direction where text runs from top to bottom and columns proceed from right to left. Used in novels, newspapers, formal letters, and traditional documents. Contrasts with horizontal writing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{縦書|たてが}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Japanese novels are mostly written vertically.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年賀状|ねんがじょう}→年賀状：06227_nengajou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{縦書|たてが}き⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一般的|いっぱんてき}→一般的：04784_ippanteki⟧だ。
examples.english: It is common to write New Year's cards in vertical format.

examples.japanese: ⟦ワープロ→ワープロ：01544_waapuro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{設定|せってい}→設定：04767_settei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{横書|よこが}き→横書き：13188_yokogaki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{縦書|たてが}き⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}した→変更する：30779_henkousuru⟧。
examples.english: I changed the word processor setting from horizontal to vertical writing.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
{縦書|たてが}き is the traditional writing direction in Japanese, Chinese, and Korean. In Japan, it remains the standard for novels, literary magazines, and formal correspondence. Newspapers use both {縦書|たてが}き (for articles) and ⟦{横書|よこが}き→横書き：13188_yokogaki⟧ (for headlines and advertisements). Digital text is increasingly ⟦{横書|よこが}き→横書き：13188_yokogaki⟧, but e-readers often offer a {縦書|たてが}き option.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{横書|よこが}き→横書き：13188_yokogaki⟧: horizontal writing (left to right)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {縦書|たてが}き⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: write vertically
- {縦書|たてが}き⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}する→変更する：30779_henkousuru⟧: change to vertical writing
- {縦書|たてが}き⟦{表示|ひょうじ}→表示：03143_hyouji⟧: vertical text display
